title: VTN — Roles and groups
description: A network's roles, and the groups its members register to serve them. A registration is the member's signed vtn/groups/register request; the network accepts it by issuing a revocable groupRegistered credential (`https://openvtc.org/vtn/vsc/groupRegistered/1`, interim OpenVTC predicate) whose `digestMultibase` is the digest of that request, and revokes it when the registration ends.

RoleName.description: A role's name: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

required.description: Whether a party must register a group for it before its acknowledgement is accepted.

SignedTask.description: A complete Trust Task document, with its proof, exactly as signed and received. Verified as a document in its own right; open so its proof still covers every member, and so its digest can be recomputed.

RegisteredGroup.description: A group serving a role: the member's signed registration and the network's groupRegistered credential accepting it.

member.description: The member that registered the group.

group.description: The group: a DID, or for a network group a DID URL on the network's DID (`<did>#role-<name>`).

endpoint.description: Where the network delivers broadcasts for the group.

acceptance.description: The network's groupRegistered credential: a statement (`https://openvtc.org/vtn/vsc/groupRegistered/1`) issued by the accepting network, subject the group, `object.digestMultibase` the digest of `registration`, with a `credentialStatus` on the network's revocation list.

registeredAt.description: When the network accepted the registration.

ChainLink.description: One registration on the path from a person's community up to the network a room belongs to: the member's signed request and the accepting network's groupRegistered credential.

acceptance.description: The network's groupRegistered credential: a statement (`https://openvtc.org/vtn/vsc/groupRegistered/1`) issued by the accepting network, subject the group, `object.digestMultibase` the digest of `registration`, with a `credentialStatus` on the network's revocation list.
